description: This Java class provides utility methods for handling web application configurations, such as retrieving web.xml information, managing dispatchers, security, and request attributes within an OFBiz-based web application.

classes.name: WebAppUtil
classes.description: Utility class for managing web application configurations and contexts within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: getControlServletPath
methods.description: Returns the control servlet path based on web.xml configuration for a given WebappInfo.

methods.name: isDistributable
methods.description: Checks if the web application is marked as distributable in web.xml.

methods.name: getWebappInfoFromWebsiteId
methods.description: Retrieves WebappInfo object based on the provided web site ID.

methods.name: getWebSiteId
methods.description: Extracts the web site ID from web.xml's context parameters.

methods.name: getDispatcher
methods.description: Retrieves or creates the LocalDispatcher associated with the ServletContext.

methods.name: setAttributesFromRequestBody
methods.description: Reads the request body (e.g., JSON) and sets parameters as request attributes.

methods.name: makeWebappDispatcher
methods.description: Creates a LocalDispatcher instance for the web application based on ServletContext and Delegator.

methods.name: getDelegator
methods.description: Obtains the Delegator instance from ServletContext or creates it based on the configured name.

methods.name: getSecurity
methods.description: Gets or initializes the Security object in the ServletContext.

methods.name: parseWebXmlFile
methods.description: Parses the web.xml file into a WebXml object, optionally validating the XML.
